fields.description: Greenway 2 is a gated townhouse neighbourhood at Emaar South with three- and four-bedroom homes. Ivy and Ilya façade styles have their own published layouts. The plans show homes across two levels, with living areas opening towards a rear terrace and bedrooms arranged around the first-floor landing.

overview: The developer presents Greenway 2 as a contemporary residential setting organised around landscaped outdoor space. The brochure identifies a community park and centre, dining, retail and the wider championship golf course. Its facilities support day-to-day leisure, but final access arrangements and the outlook of an individual townhouse require a plot-specific check.
research.locationNote: Greenway 2 is part of Emaar South in Dubai South, connected by the surrounding road network towards Al Maktoum International Airport and Expo City Dubai. Marketing journey times are not treated as guaranteed commuting times.
research.priceNote: Emaar currently displays AED 2.7m. The June 2024 launch fact sheet instead lists starts of AED 2.72m for three bedrooms and AED 3.11m for four bedrooms. The small headline difference is retained transparently; none of these figures is a current unit quotation.
research.paymentNote: The launch plan comprises ten equal payments: 10% on booking, 80% in later construction-period instalments and 10% on completion. Current developer or resale terms should be confirmed for the selected home.
research.handoverNote: The launch plan estimates May 2028 completion, also reported by Property Finder. Q2 2028 remains provisional and subject to the sale agreement and actual construction programme.

facts.label: Published unit mix
facts.value: The launch sheet lists 492 homes: 246 three-bedroom and 246 four-bedroom townhouses. Availability must be checked separately.

facts.label: Area basis
facts.value: Plan totals include the suite, garage and balcony/terrace allocation. Plot figures above are launch averages, not minimum/maximum ranges or measurements for a particular home.

facts.label: Ivy four-bedroom example
facts.value: The ground floor contains a guest bedroom, bathroom, maid’s room, laundry and carport. Three bedrooms are upstairs, including the main suite with walk-in wardrobe and balcony.

facts.label: Cluster arrangement
facts.value: The brochure describes clusters of two, while the detailed plan key explicitly shows four homes, TH01–TH04. Use the selected plot’s approved plan to establish its actual neighbours and position.
